asset.description: Asset id (`a_` + 16 hex digits, see list_assets). Preferred over `source`.

crop.description: Media clips on video tracks: the part of the source frame to show, as fractions of the frame with the origin at its top-left. Absent = the whole frame. x, y in 0..1; w, h from 0.02 to 1; x+w and y+h at most 1. Applied before the clip is scaled to fit the output frame, so for a vertical short compute it with the `crop_for_aspect` helper (CLI `compose crop --aspect 9:16`, MCP `set_clip_crop`, GET /api/v1/assets/{id}/reframe) rather than by hand.

x.description: Left edge (fraction of the source width).

y.description: Top edge (fraction of the source height).

font_size.description: Text height as a fraction of the frame height (text clips only).

id.description: Clip id; generated deterministically from the plan when absent.

in.description: Seconds into the source where the clip starts (text clips: 0).

kind.description: `media` (a piece of an asset) or `text` (a title).

out.description: Seconds into the source where the clip ends (default: the end of the asset). Required for text clips, where `out - in` is how long the title shows.

scale.description: Overlay width as a fraction of the frame width.

source.description: A file path relative to the workspace root that is already an asset; used when `asset` is absent.

start.description: Where the clip begins on the timeline, in seconds. Only on non-magnetic tracks; default: right after the previous clip on the track.

transition.description: How this clip joins the one before it. `crossfade` only on magnetic tracks, never on the first clip.

transition_duration.description: Crossfade length in seconds; required (above 0) with `crossfade`.

x.description: Overlay centre, as a fraction of the frame width.

y.description: Overlay centre, as a fraction of the frame height (text: 0.85).

id.description: Track id; generated deterministically from the plan when absent.

magnetic.description: A magnetic track keeps its clips back to back in list order (the main track); clips on other tracks are placed with `start` and may not overlap. Default: true for the first video track, false for the others.

description: One JSON document that creates or replaces a whole timeline project atomically. Strict: unknown fields are rejected. Constraints this schema cannot express (asset ids exist, in/out within the asset, no overlaps, crossfade room, at most 2000 clips in total) are checked by the server and reported with stable codes; see docs/edit-plan.md.

base_revision.description: Mode `replace`: the revision of the project this plan was written against; the write fails with a 409 / revision conflict if it has moved on. null or absent in mode `create`.

meta.description: Free-form notes for the caller; echoed in the response, never stored or validated.

mode.description: `create` fails if the project exists; `replace` rewrites an existing project and needs `base_revision` or `replace_unconditionally`.

project.description: Name of the timeline project to create or replace (no path, no extension).

replace_unconditionally.description: Mode `replace` only: overwrite whatever revision is stored, losing any edit made since you last looked. The explicit alternative to `base_revision`.

schema_version.description: Version of this plan format. Additive optional fields keep the version; a breaking change bumps it.

tracks.description: The tracks, bottom to top: a later video track draws over an earlier one.
